user.title: Set up TeddyCloud Home Assistant Integration

discover.title: Prepare your Toniebox for discovery
discover.description: **Turn on the Toniebox or place a figurine on it.** Optionally enter an MQTT prefix (for example `teddyCloud` or `myTeddy`). Leave it empty to search across prefixes. Press OK to start; discovery finishes as soon as a matching box is found.

not_found.title: No Toniebox found yet
not_found.description: Your Toniebox may not have sent any MQTT messages. Wake it up and try again, or enter its box ID manually.

manual.title: Add a Toniebox manually
manual.description: Enter the box ID and its MQTT prefix (for example `myTeddy` instead of `teddyCloud`).

scan_result.title: Choose a discovered Toniebox
scan_result.description: Select your Toniebox and give it a name.

scan.title: Searching – turn on the Toniebox or place a figurine
scan.description: **Turn on the Toniebox or place a figurine on it now.** Discovery ends immediately once a box is detected over MQTT, or after 25 seconds at the latest.

progress.searching_boxes: Turn on the Toniebox or place a figurine on it – waiting for MQTT messages…
